deletionRequest.subject: Index Tennis — account deletion request
deletionRequest.body:
Hello,

I request deletion of my Index Tennis account and its associated personal data. Where possible, I am writing from the email address linked to my account.

Please let me know if proportionate account-ownership verification is needed, explain any information that will remain, and confirm when the request has been completed.

Thank you.
deletionRequest.instruction: The address above is selectable. You can use your own email service or open a suggested request below. Sending an email starts a request; it does not instantly delete your account.
deletionRequest.copyFailure: The address could not be copied automatically. It is selected where supported; copy it manually or use the email link.

support.title: Support — Index Tennis
support.heading: HERE TO HELP.
support.description: Get help with Index Tennis sign-in, clubs, matches, levels, notifications and account deletion. Contact support directly by email.
support.intro: Help with your Index Tennis account, your matches and your level. No sign-in or app installation is needed to contact us.

sections.title: Contact Index Tennis
paragraphs: Email {{support}} for support. Privacy and personal-data questions can be sent to {{privacy}}. These addresses may use the same inbox.
For help with Index Tennis, use the email address above. We do not promise a fixed support response time.

links.label: Delete your account — in the app or by email
How Index Tennis uses your data

sections.title: Tell us what happened
paragraphs: Describe the screen or action involved, what you expected, what actually happened and roughly when. Include the app version, device model and iOS/Android version if useful. A screenshot can help, but hide unrelated personal information first.

For an account issue, use the email linked to your account where possible. Never send passwords, login codes, access tokens or unnecessary identity documents. We do not need your login code to investigate.
items: Sign-in problem: your sign-in method and any visible error, without the code itself.
Match problem: date, opponent and the disputed score, sharing only what is needed.
Bug: short steps to reproduce it and whether trying again changed anything.

sections.title: Abusive profiles, photos or privacy concerns
paragraphs: Email support about impersonation, abusive names, inappropriate profile photos or other misuse. Identify the profile or match and explain the concern, with a screenshot if appropriate. Do not send sensitive material that is not needed to understand the report.
Use {{privacy}} to raise a data-protection concern or exercise a privacy right. Index does not currently offer an in-app reporting or blocking tool; email is the contact route.

faqs.q: My sign-in code has not arrived. What should I do?
faqs.a: Check the email address, spam folder and email filtering. Wait until the app allows a resend, then request a fresh code and use the latest one. Apple and Google sign-in are also supported. If the issue continues, email support with your sign-in method and the visible error; never send a code.

Sign in with an email code, Apple or Google, then complete your player profile, initial level assessment and home-club choice. Select your club from the Spanish directory; you do not need the club to adopt Index before you can use it.

faqs.q: How do I choose or change my club?
faqs.a: Choose a listed club by name or municipality during onboarding, or change your home club in Settings. You keep the same national level. If your club is missing, use the app’s club-request option; an unapproved request has restricted visibility until reviewed.

It is still settling. You need at least five rated matches and enough information about your level; the label can remain after the fifth. Provisional players appear in club, province, autonomous-community and Spain rankings, clearly labelled.

faqs.q: How do I report and confirm a match?
faqs.a: Record a singles match, choose your opponent and enter the score. Your opponent can review and confirm it or dispute it. Only opponent-confirmed matches affect levels. Both players should check the score before confirmation.

faqs.q: What happens to disputed or unanswered results?
faqs.a: A disputed result does not affect levels. A result that remains unanswered expires after seven days and does not affect levels. Pending, disputed and expired matches are visible only to the participants. Contact support if you need help with an incorrect result; do not report a false score to offset it.

faqs.q: Can I play someone from another club?
faqs.a: Yes. You can record a singles match against another player in the app. Your level is national; geographic rankings are different views of that same level. Club affiliation is self-declared and is not proof of membership.

faqs.q: Why am I not receiving notifications?
faqs.a: Push notifications are optional. Check the app’s notification settings and the phone’s permission settings, as well as focus/do-not-disturb modes and connectivity. You can still open Index to review pending results without allowing push notifications.

faqs.q: How do I delete my account?
faqs.a: In the app, open Player/Profile → Settings → Delete account. Without the app, email the address on the Delete Account page. Uninstalling the app alone does not delete your account. That page explains verification, retained match history and external deletion retries.

faqs.q: Does Index charge for subscriptions or purchases?
faqs.a: The current app is free. There are no implemented subscriptions, advertising or in-app purchases.

privacy.title: Privacy policy — Index Tennis
privacy.heading: YOUR DATA. EXPLAINED.
privacy.description: Index Tennis privacy policy: account and match data, profile visibility, providers, website privacy, retention, deletion and your rights.
privacy.intro: This policy covers the Index Tennis mobile app and indextennis.com. It explains what information is used, who can see it and how to contact the operator.

sections.title: 1. Who is responsible
paragraphs: Index Tennis is operated by {{operator}}, an individual based in {{country}}, who is the controller of the personal data described in this policy.
For privacy questions and rights requests, email {{privacy}}. For general help, email {{support}}.

sections.title: 2. Information and its sources
paragraphs: You provide account/profile details and scores. Your opponents provide match information about you. Apple, Google and Supabase provide sign-in information for the method you choose. Technical information is generated when you use the service.

rows: Account and sign-in
Email address, authentication identifier, sign-in method and session/security records. Apple or Google may provide an identifier, email and name where shared, including an Apple private-relay email.
Player profile
Chosen display name, optional profile photo, initial self-assessment, home club and changes, and club requests you submit.
Matches and levels
Opponent, score, match date, confirmation/dispute/expiry status, national level, uncertainty/provisional status and rating history. Information comes from both players and the rating calculation.
Club directory
Club names, municipalities, provinces and autonomous communities from the Spanish directory and submitted corrections/requests. A home-club choice does not give precise device location.
Optional notifications
Push token, platform, language, registration activity, delivery status and the match information in a notification.
Diagnostics and security

App/backend error reports, app/device/software versions, request timestamps and technical connection records. Providers can receive IP addresses and service logs; not every such record is part of the app’s error payload.
Correspondence
Your email address, message content, relevant account details and any attachments you choose to send to support or privacy.
Website requests
IP address and technical HTTP information needed to deliver pages, which may appear in hosting/access/security logs depending on the host’s configuration.

sections.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: Processing is not all based on consent. The basis depends on the purpose, and optional permissions do not authorise unrelated uses.

rows: Provide the requested app service
Account, sign-in, profile, club choice, matches and ratings
Performance of the service contract (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)); profile/ranking visibility is part of the service described here.
Security, reliability and resolving misuse
Necessary technical logs, diagnostics and relevant reports
Legitimate interests in securing and maintaining the service (Article 6(1)(f)), with minimisation and a balancing assessment.
Optional photos and push alerts
Photo you upload; push token and delivery content if enabled
Your optional choice/permission, with consent where required (Article 6(1)(a)). Removing a photo or disabling alerts does not close the account.
Support and privacy correspondence
Contact details and information needed for the request
Contractual support where applicable; legitimate interests for general enquiries; legal obligations when handling data-protection rights (Article 6(1)(c)).
Deliver and secure this website
Necessary connection and security information
Legitimate interests in delivering and protecting the website; no analytics or advertising processing is added by this repository.

sections.title: 4. Who can see profiles and matches
paragraphs: Other signed-in Index players, including players outside your club, can see your display name, optional photo, level, provisional status and listed home-club information. Rankings cover club, province, autonomous community and Spain. Provisional players are included with a visible label.
items: Confirmed match information is visible to other signed-in players while both accounts are active. After a participant deletes their account, a retained shared result is visible only to its participants.
Pending, disputed and expired matches are visible only to their participants through the app’s match views.
An unapproved club request has restricted visibility. The requester and reviewing platform administrator can access its unlisted details. Other players are not shown that unlisted club identity.
Profile photos use publicly readable storage URLs. Someone who obtains a photo URL may access it outside the app. Choose an image you are comfortable sharing.

sections.title: 5. Service providers and recipients
paragraphs: Providers receive information relevant to their role, not automatically the entire dataset. They may also process operational/security logs or account information under their own applicable terms. Apple and Google can act independently for their sign-in/device services as well as participating in delivery.

rows: Fly.io
Backend hosting and request processing; technical connection/security records and data processed by the API.
Neon
Application database holding player, match, club, notification and rating records; database operations/backups and technical logs.
Supabase
Authentication/session information and optional profile-photo storage; related service logs.
Brevo
Delivery of login-code emails through the configured mail service: recipient address, email content and delivery metadata.
Expo Push, Apple APNs, Google FCM
Optional push delivery: push identifiers, notification content and delivery/technical metadata along the delivery chain.
Apple and Google sign-in
Authentication identifiers and profile/email information shared for the sign-in method you choose.
Sentry
App/backend error monitoring. The integration strips user context, request headers/cookies and sensitive URL data; connection and service-level logs may still exist at providers.
Zoho
Support/privacy email correspondence, sender/recipient addresses, content, attachments and mail/security metadata.
Cloudflare Pages
{{websiteHost}}: page delivery and related access/security logs. Processing region: {{websiteRegion}} Log retention: {{websiteLogRetention}}

sections.title: 6. Processing locations and transfers
paragraphs: The current app environment uses Frankfurt/EU configurations for Fly.io, Neon and Supabase and an EU Sentry region. Provider support, security logs, account information, subprocessors and notification delivery can involve processing outside the European Economic Area.

Cloudflare Pages delivers this website through a global network. Cloudflare’s published self-service terms incorporate its data processing addendum. That addendum provides for Data Privacy Framework transfers where applicable and EU Standard Contractual Clauses for restricted transfers. Other providers publish their own processing terms and safeguards. You can contact us for information about the safeguards relevant to your data.

sections.title: 7. Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Account information is used while the account is active for the purposes described above. Account deletion replaces the profile name with “Former player”, removes its sign-in link and unnecessary club context, removes the player from search and rankings, removes registered notification tokens and notifications, and expires pending matches.

The sign-in identity and photos are removed through Supabase. Cleanup includes the assigned profile photo and other uploads under that account’s photo folder. Failed external deletions are retried. A technical refusal marker prevents old app sessions from being used while cleanup continues.

Confirmed matches and rating history can remain linked to a de-identified “Former player” record to preserve opponents’ results and reproducible levels. Retained shared results become participant-only. Scores, dates, opponents and internal rating references can still make a person identifiable from context.
Retention criteria for these records: {{historyDuration}}
Legal basis for limited retained history: {{historyBasis}}

The deleted sign-in identifier is kept during external cleanup and for a two-day stale-session refusal period after successful Auth deletion. Repeated and final photo-folder cleanup must succeed before its marker is retired. Provider failures or service interruptions can delay completion.

Deletion requests are handled manually through support with ownership verification. Case and correspondence information is retained to handle the request, follow up incomplete cleanup and address related questions or legal obligations. We assess erasure and restriction requests for those records too. Provider logs and backups follow their own retention criteria. Website logs are described below.

A backup made after erasure preserves the erased state. An older backup may contain earlier data. If recovery from such a backup is necessary, deletion records must be reapplied before the restored service is made available.

links.label: Deletion routes, verification and retained records

sections.title: 8. This website, cookies and contact messages
paragraphs: This website serves static pages with locally hosted fonts and images. It uses no advertising trackers, analytics, third-party embeds, website accounts or contact form. It does not use cookies or browser storage for tracking. The deletion page can copy the contact address when you activate the copy button.

Email links open your mail service so you can send a message to Index Tennis. Correspondence is handled through Zoho. Cloudflare Pages processes IP addresses and technical request or network information to deliver and protect the website.

Cloudflare’s necessary security or access cookies depend on the features enabled for the request. No cookies or analytics beacon were observed in our website checks. Hosting and security processing can occur across Cloudflare’s global network. Website log retention: {{websiteLogRetention}}

sections.title: 9. Your rights and how to use them
paragraphs: Where applicable, you can request access, correction, erasure, restriction and portability of your personal data, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. You may withdraw consent for consent-based processing without affecting earlier lawful processing. You can also complain to the Spanish data-protection authority (AEPD) or another competent supervisory authority.
Email {{privacy}}. Use your account-associated email where possible; only proportionate verification will be requested if needed. Do not send passwords, login codes or unnecessary identity documents.

We respond without undue delay and normally within {{responseMonths}} calendar month of receiving a rights request. If the law permits an extension because of complexity or number of requests, we explain it within that first month; the extension can be up to two further months. A response deadline is not a guarantee that every external deletion has finished. Rights requests are normally free.

sections.title: 10. Minimum age
paragraphs: Index Tennis is not intended for children under {{minimumAge}}. There is no parental-consent feature. If you believe an underage child has supplied personal data, contact {{privacy}} so the situation can be reviewed and appropriate action taken.

sections.title: 11. Automated level calculations
paragraphs: The app calculates an estimated tennis level from confirmed results and rating rules. Rankings and provisional labels reflect that estimate and the available information. These are sporting references, not an official federation certification. Contact support about an inaccurate result or an unexpected calculation.

sections.title: 12. Security and limits
paragraphs: Access controls, encrypted service connections and data minimisation help protect information. No service can guarantee absolute security. Limit what you put in public-facing names/photos or send in support messages, and keep access to your sign-in provider secure.

sections.title: 13. Changes and contact
paragraphs: The effective and last-updated date appears at the top of this policy. We will explain material changes where required. Contact {{privacy}} with questions about this policy.

terms.title: Terms of use — Index Tennis
terms.heading: PLAY FAIR. USE INDEX FAIRLY.
terms.description: Index Tennis terms covering accounts, honest match reporting, levels, self-declared clubs, conduct, user content and consumer rights.
terms.intro: These terms describe use of Index Tennis, an amateur singles-tennis app, and its public information website.

sections.title: 1. Operator and scope
paragraphs: Index Tennis is provided by {{operator}}, operating under the name Index Tennis and based in {{country}}. You can contact Index Tennis at {{support}}.

The current app is free and has no implemented subscriptions, advertising or in-app purchases. These terms do not introduce a charge. Any future paid service would need separate, clear information and an appropriate agreement.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility and account responsibilities
paragraphs: You must be at least {{minimumAge}} and have the legal capacity or legally required authorisation to use the service. Index is not intended for under-{{minimumAge}} users and does not provide a parental-consent flow.

Use an account you control, keep your sign-in provider secure and provide honest account information. Email-code, Apple and Google sign-in are supported. Never give another person your login code. You remain responsible for your own conduct; this does not make you liable for every unauthorised act regardless of circumstances.
Visiting this website does not create an app account or record acceptance of terms. Any required acceptance must be obtained through an appropriate process.

sections.title: 3. Honest match reporting
paragraphs: Record only real singles matches with accurate opponents, dates and scores. Do not invent matches, impersonate an opponent, coordinate false confirmations or manipulate results.

The opponent can confirm or dispute the reported result. Only opponent-confirmed matches affect levels. Unanswered matches expire after seven days. Disputed and expired results do not affect levels. Contact support about an error.

Pending, disputed and expired matches are visible only to participants. Confirmed matches can be seen by other signed-in players while both accounts are active. A retained shared result becomes participant-only after one of its players deletes their account.

sections.title: 4. Levels are estimates
paragraphs: Each player has one national level, viewed through club, province, autonomous-community and Spain rankings. Levels estimate tennis performance from available results; they are not guarantees of playing ability, match outcomes or official sporting status.

A level is provisional until there is sufficient information, including at least five rated matches. Provisional players appear in all rankings with a visible label. Levels and positions can change as results are confirmed, corrected or recalculated, or rating rules evolve. Repeated matches may carry less weight.

sections.title: 5. Home clubs and affiliation
paragraphs: You choose a home club from the Spanish directory and can change it without starting a new level. Club affiliation is self-declared. A listing, home-club choice or ranking does not prove membership, club approval or federation endorsement.
Unapproved club requests have additional privacy restrictions until reviewed. Directory information can contain errors; contact support or use the available request process to raise them.

sections.title: 6. Respect other players
paragraphs: Do not harass, threaten, discriminate, impersonate, expose others’ private information or use unlawful, abusive or inappropriate names or photos. Do not upload content you lack the right to share, disrupt the service, bypass access controls or scrape personal information for misuse.

Report inappropriate content or abuse by email with enough context to investigate. Index currently has no in-app reporting/blocking tool. The operator may investigate and take proportionate action within available controls and applicable law; where appropriate, concerns and reasons should be explained and a way to respond offered.

links.label: Contact support about abuse or a profile

sections.title: 7. Your content and limited permissions
paragraphs: You keep your rights in the content you submit. You allow Index and the service providers needed to operate it to host, process, display and technically adapt that content only as necessary to provide and protect the service described in the privacy policy.

This permission does not authorise unrelated advertising or sale of your content. Removing content or closing an account ends use that is no longer necessary, subject to the limited retained records and deletion processing explained in the privacy/deletion pages and applicable rights.
Do not present Index branding or another person’s content as your own or imply an endorsement that does not exist.

sections.title: 8. Support and closing an account
paragraphs: You can stop using the service and request account deletion in the app or by email without reinstalling it. Uninstalling alone does not close the account. Deletion removes personal profile and sign-in information and starts provider photo and identity cleanup. Limited de-identified match and rating records can remain as explained in the privacy and deletion pages.
Contact {{support}} for assistance. We handle account or content concerns proportionately, taking account of applicable user rights.

sections.title: 9. Availability, changes and responsibility
paragraphs: Maintenance, errors, provider outages and changes can interrupt the service. Index does not promise uninterrupted availability or error-free level estimates. Reasonable care remains due, and this wording does not exclude responsibility that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Features and terms may change. Material changes and any action required from users will be explained where the law requires it. Changes do not remove accrued rights or retrospectively authorise unrelated use of personal data. You may contact support or close your account if you no longer wish to use the service.

sections.title: 10. Applicable law and your rights
paragraphs: Spanish law applies to the extent a valid choice of law can be made. If you are a consumer, this does not deprive you of mandatory protections or access to competent courts available under applicable law, including protections of your habitual residence where relevant.

Nothing here waives non-excludable consumer/data-protection rights or requires arbitration or an exclusive foreign court. Contact the operator first if you wish to raise a problem; this does not restrict your ability to seek other lawful remedies.

delete-account.title: Delete your account — Index Tennis
delete-account.heading: DELETE YOUR INDEX TENNIS ACCOUNT.
delete-account.description: Delete an Index Tennis account in the app or request deletion by email without signing in or reinstalling. Learn what is deleted and what remains.
delete-account.intro: Two ways to request deletion of your Index Tennis account. You can use the email route without signing in, having the app installed or reinstalling it.

sections.title: 1. In the app
paragraphs: Open Index Tennis and follow these steps:
items: Choose Delete account, review the explanation and confirm the deletion.

sections.title: 2. Without the app: email your request
paragraphs: Write to {{privacy}} from your account-associated email where possible. If you no longer have access to it, explain that in your message so proportionate ownership verification can be arranged. You do not need to log in or reinstall the app to use this route.

sections.title: Ownership verification
paragraphs: We may verify that you control the account. For requests by email, this can involve a separate deletion-specific confirmation challenge sent to the account-associated mailbox. Never send your password, app login codes, access tokens or unnecessary identity documents.

If you used Sign in with Apple and Hide My Email, the account may use an Apple private-relay address. Tell us you used that method and provide the relay address from your Apple sign-in settings if available. If you cannot access that mailbox, explain this so an appropriate alternative verification route can be considered.

sections.title: What deletion does
paragraphs: After the account deletion is processed:
items: The profile name becomes “Former player”. Its sign-in link and unnecessary club context are removed, and its Auth identity is deleted through the authentication provider.
The player disappears from search and rankings. Registered notification tokens and notifications are removed.
The photo reference is removed. Cleanup removes the assigned photo and other uploads from the account’s photo folder, including unassigned images.
Pending matches involving the player expire. A retained confirmed result is visible only to its participants.
Old app sessions are refused. External photo or sign-in deletion failures are retried, and repeated folder cleanup addresses uploads made with stale Storage tokens during the refusal period.

sections.title: What currently remains
paragraphs: Confirmed match records and rating history can remain attached to a de-identified “Former player” record to preserve opponents’ results and reproducible levels. They can include scores, dates, opponents and internal historical references. Retained shared results are participant-only. Other players’ levels are preserved.
Match context can sometimes identify a former player. Retention criteria: {{historyDuration}}
Legal basis: {{historyBasis}}

Technical deletion records remain while provider cleanup is pending and during a two-day stale-session refusal period after Auth deletion. Final photo-folder cleanup must also succeed. Logs, backups and support correspondence have their own purposes and retention criteria, described in the privacy policy.

links.label: Privacy policy: retention and your rights

sections.title: What happens after you contact us
paragraphs: Sending the email starts a manually handled request. We verify ownership where necessary, process account removal and explain the outcome, including retained records and any provider cleanup still pending. An email request does not instantly delete the account.

We respond without undue delay and normally within {{responseMonths}} calendar month of receiving a privacy-rights request. If complexity or the number of requests permits a legal extension, we explain the reason within that first month. The extension can be up to two further months. This response deadline is separate from retained match history and external retry processing.
